panels.heading: Strategic Thinking
panels.support: Taking in information and deciding what to do.

notes: This is the cohesive exercise for the day. StrengthsFinder 2.0 has 34 themes across these four domains.
Reading the book and completing the assessment was homework. A leader who has not taken it shares at the next weekly meeting.
Allow about 25 minutes for both slides.

slides.title: What are your top five strengths?
slides.headline: What are your top five strengths?
slides.support: Post your top five strengths, in the order the assessment ranks them.
body: Share your strengths with the team.
Then talk about what the team’s mix shows across the four domains.
notes: The view of the whole team matters as much as each person’s list.
Homework: each leader does the same with their own team, and builds one view of every team member.
